name: Juniper
diet: acacia browse twice daily, pelleted ration, alfalfa hay
conditions: mild arthritis in left foreleg, on a daily joint supplement
baseline_notes: Normally finishes the morning browse within 45 minutes and is first to the feeder.

name: Gentoo colony (14 birds)
diet: capelin and sprat, vitamin-dosed, three feeds daily
conditions: two birds treated for bumblefoot earlier this year, both healed
baseline_notes: Water must stay below 10 C with clear water for foraging; flock stress rises quickly when the pool circulation changes.

name: Biscuit
baseline_notes: Sleeps through the afternoon; reduced afternoon activity is normal. Reduced morning activity is not.

name: Mosswood
diet: grass hay, vegetables, pelleted rodent ration
baseline_notes: Watch for drooling or dropping food; incisors need monitoring.

name: Pebble
diet: clams, crab, squid; ~25 percent of body weight daily
baseline_notes: Grooms constantly; a pelt that looks matted or a refusal to groom signals illness or water-quality problems.
